analysis.reasonEn: Switched to buy after 3 consecutive sessions of waiting. RSI moved from 51.5 to 58.6, exiting oversold territory, and MACD histogram improved from 1.0949 to 0.8218. While the current price of $375.30 is below the 5-day high of $378.36 and 20-day high of $384.04, suggesting a potential Lower High pattern, the RSI recovery and Higher Low pattern take precedence. Weekly RSI remains neutral at 50.3. ADX is in the early stages of trend formation at 21.2.
